verdicts.note: FAIL. The dashboard's only network call rewrites the shared transport by hand instead of using it. dashboard/src/lib/useRuns.ts:8 sets its own FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000. Lines 59-68 then hand-write fetch with `AbortSignal.timeout`, `if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)` and `await res.json()`. design-system/http.ts:61 already exports `requestJson<T>(path, schema, init?, timeoutMs)`, which does the timeout, the status check (throwing an HttpError that carries `status`) and a parse through a Zod-shaped `{ parse }` parser. DEFAULT_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS is exported at http.ts:18. The file's own header comment names this duplication: every app had written 'a timeout constant, a fetch that pulls { error } out of a failed body before throwing'. `requestJson(url, { parse: parseRunsFeed }, undefined, 10_000)` would replace the hand-written block, and describeFetchError/feedState would stay as they are. The cross-origin URL is no obstacle: requestJson is a plain fetch(path), and its only added header, `accept`, is CORS-safelisted. No dashboard file imports http.ts. Two smaller points: relativeTime.ts:7-30 hand-writes relative-time bucketing, with the unit suffixes in en.ts:335-342, instead of using Intl.RelativeTimeFormat. RunList.tsx:169-183 StatusIcon repeats the `passed ? '✓' : '!'` glyph and the success/error colour pairs that StatusBadge.tsx:19,36-37 already owns. The rest of the app reuses the shared library properly: Page (components/Page.tsx:6), SafeExternalLink (RunList.tsx:3, RunHeader.tsx:2), linkify (lib/linkify.tsx:8), useDocumentMeta (lib/useDocumentMeta.ts:7-10) and safeUrl (lib/summary.ts:3).

PASS. I opened all seven page files. None has inline markup, CSSProperties objects or style props. Each return is a short list of named components. Home.tsx:55-64 owns state: it calls useRuns() at :62 and useState for the query at :63, then passes both to HomeBody. HomeBody (:25-52) picks one branch per feed state, each rendering Page with LoadingNote, AlertNote, or AlertNote plus RunsOverview. RunsOverview.tsx:25-49 composes KpiStrip, ScoreNote, RunSearch, and either StatusNote or RunList, with the query passed down as a controlled prop. RunDetail.tsx:101-116 owns useParams and useRuns and hands them to RunDetailView (:52-93). Each branch there renders Page with LoadingNote/AlertNote/StatusNote/BackToRunsLink, or with RunDetailBody (:28-36 = RunHeader, IterationHistory, RuleBreakdown). NotFound.tsx:25-30 is Page, StatusNote and BackToRunsLink. About, Terms, Privacy and Contact (lines 14-18 in each) are Page wrapping ContentSections, with the text coming from en.pages.*. The only non-JSX logic in the pages is useDocumentMeta, the one-line detailTitle helper (RunDetail.tsx:19-21) and the slug lookup (:72), which is page-level selection and belongs in the page.
